dependencies.upstream_resolution_rule: Exactly one resolution per entry: slug/slugs, terminal+kind, or unresolved.
dependencies.edge_kind_rule: backing = solvency dependency; venue = exit price dependency.
dependencies.coverage_note: Issuer-listed book only. 60.17% lending and 19.88% external LP legs. Share metrics overlap payout, protocol and chain layers: never sum them or render as a partition. Wrapper pricing and admin discretion are assessed on Axis 5, not duplicated here. Downstream is generated only in an isolated graph build; pending file is not loaded by serving graph.
dependencies.upstream_unanchored_note: frxUSD has a numeric 4.5 ceiling but dominant WTGXX/USTB/BUIDL and bank-cash dependency reports remain unresolved; terminal protocol labels do not establish exhaustive external risk assessment.

downstream_basis.asserted_only_note: None — every asserted edge is reproducible from an upstream array.
downstream_basis.do_not_hand_edit: ⚠️ downstream_tracked is GENERATED. Hand-maintaining both directions is how fxsave came to list fxUSD as BOTH its upstream and its downstream — one edge recorded twice, in opposite directions. Add the edge to the UPSTREAM array of the dependent asset and re-run build.
